purpose: Common fast decoding, fixed-horizon anytime quality curves, and larger weak-MIS instances
learning: Same public network and indexed MIS objective as prior controlled evaluation. Adam 1e-4, weight decay 5e-8, penalty 2, uniform features, effective dropout zero; no new hyperparameter selection.
annealing: Weak CRA uses fixed 30-second horizon: -1+1.6*min(1,elapsed setup+training+online decoding / 30). Strong coefficient zero. Early checkpoints are not independent runs with compressed schedules.
neural_selection: Empty feasible incumbent at time zero. Decode first pre-update training forward, then approximately every 1 second and 0.1s before each cutoff. Only candidates whose complete decoding is available by cutoff may enter that snapshot; first maximum wins ties. All online decoding is charged. Save every candidate plus best/latest prefix indices and initial/terminal roles.
random_selection: Single seeded RNG trajectory for 30 seconds with same fast decoder; empty incumbent then first trial and prefix-best. Store per-trial completed time/size and all improving candidate scores. Snapshots use only trials complete by cutoff, with total trials and best trial index.
scip: Independent 5/15/30-second targets with event-traced incumbents and past bounds. Single thread, fast equivalent degree warm start, Python construction deducted, minimum solver 1ms. Primary snapshot uses only events complete by cutoff; late terminal solution/optimality excluded and saved as completion diagnostic.
timing: Snapshot emission can overshoot a target between operations; save cutoff, actual emitted total_seconds, best_available_seconds, overshoot and deadline_missed. Quality uses strict past-completed prefixes, never future candidates. Complete seed trajectory and its snapshots saved atomically; do not splice resumed trajectories. JSON writes and independent verification excluded.
scope: Synthetic seeds are new; previously examined real data are explicitly re-evaluated, not unseen test data. Larger instances focus on weak MIS. Related synthetic structures and repeated seeds are descriptive, not independent statistical replicates. A checkpoint is not an independent training run.
